item.title: RideNow dealerships post double-digit sales increase at Bike Week | Powersports Business
item.description: RideNow's Indian Motorcycle Daytona Beach, along with its sister store, RideNow Daytona Beach, increased its Bike Week sales by 40% and 32%, respectively.

item.title: AMA announces schedule for 2026 National Gypsy Tour, HOF ceremony | Powersports Business
item.description: The next stop on the Gypsy Tour is at Americade May 27-30 in Lake George, New York; the AMA Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony will be held Sept. 10.

item.title: Super73 unveils new line of A-Series e-bikes | Powersports Business
item.description: Super73 introduced its latest A-Series models, featuring a novel lineup that shakes up the brand’s traditional platform DNA with redesigned frames and technology.

item.title: Can-Am transforms Defender into ultimate hunting rig for MeatEater | Powersports Business
item.description: The purpose-built UTV blends Can‑Am engineering, S3 Powersports fabrication, and MeatEater’s field-tested expertise into a one‑of‑a‑kind hunting rig.

item.title: Triumph unveils limited edition Street Triple, announces sustainable fuel program | Powersports Business
item.description: Fans can vote for their favorite rider each round and enter a prize drawing to win their own No. 765 Triumph Street Triple Moto2 Edition with a matching engraving.

item.title: BRP names winners of its 6th International Design Challenge | Powersports Business
item.description: The annual competition, endorsed by the World Design Organization, challenged students to develop emergency response vehicle (ERV) concepts aligned with United Nations sustainability goals.

item.title: NPDA calls on dealers for roundtable discussion with investors | Powersports Business
item.description: NPDA and BMO Capital Markets are inviting a dozen dealers to share real-world market insight directly with institutional investors during a private roundtable.

item.title: SEMA expands 2026 show with dedicated powersports section | Powersports Business
item.description: SEMA will significantly expand its powersports footprint at the 2026 SEMA Show, introducing a dedicated Powersports / SxS / Lifestyle section aimed at better serving powersports dealers and aftermarket businesses.

item.title: Indian Motorcycle leads again as dealers miss half of web leads
item.description: According to the 2026 Internet Lead Effectiveness (ILE) study from Pied Piper, Indian dealers earned the highest average score at 55, marking the fourth consecutive year the brand has led the rankings.

item.title: Buy-sell transaction of two Virginia H-D dealerships officially close | Powersports Business
item.description: The deal, initially reported on Feb. 24, involved the estate of Mary Hughes selling to the largest Harley-Davidson dealership group in the country, MOD Enterprises.
